sections.title: Summary
sections.content: Solution Architect and Mobile Architecture Lead with 15+ years of experience delivering complex digital products across fintech, payments, banking, trading, and travel. Strong track record of owning end-to-end solution design, defining target architectures, and guiding delivery through governance, risk management, and architectural quality attributes. Combines hands-on engineering depth in mobile and cross-platform delivery with a pragmatic architecture mindset that connects business goals to executable technical roadmaps. Experienced in discovery/RFP work, technical audits, performance optimisation, and establishing observability and CI/CD standards to improve production readiness. Proven leader within engineering and architecture communities, contributing to capability development through mentoring, standards, reviews, and knowledge-sharing programs.

content.name: Payment tokenization integration proof of concept
content.overview: Proof of Concept for integrating internal token/payment capabilities with an external card tokenization service using a modular, enterprise-ready architecture. Demonstrates external tokenization API integration while keeping core business logic independent from specific frameworks and providers.
responsibilities: Owned end-to-end solution architecture and target technical design.
Produced architecture artifacts including LLD, ADRs, C4 diagrams, module boundaries, and integration contracts.
Supervised implementation to ensure architectural compliance across core, adapters, and application wiring.
Defined non-functional guidelines for extensibility, separation of concerns, integration reliability, configuration, and security baseline.
Coordinated technical decisions with development teams and reviewed key design and implementation choices.

content.name: Mobile trading app
content.overview: Comprehensive mobile trading platform for experienced traders and newcomers, providing access to CFDs, forex, indices, shares, commodities, ETFs, crypto, and other financial markets.
responsibilities: Performed technical audits and resolved performance bottlenecks.
Analyzed requirements and designed technical solutions.
Led risk analysis, backlog breakdown, estimations, documentation, and code/design review.

content.name: Payment API documentation review
content.overview: Validation of Payment Provider Developer Portal documentation for completeness, usability, clarity, and effectiveness compared to competitors, including an improvements roadmap.
responsibilities: Collected and analyzed client and competitor documentation.
Evaluated documentation against an API maturity framework.
Assessed UI/UX and compiled recommendations.
Prepared backlog breakdown and estimations.

content.name: Transport services discovery phase
content.overview: B2C automotive super app bringing customer services under one roof, including license services, buying, selling, renting, leasing, servicing, and vehicle repairs.
responsibilities: Owned technical discovery and converted business vision into architecture options.
Estimated scope and decomposed backlog.
Led risk analysis across mobile platform choices and integrations.

content.name: Smart lock access management app
content.overview: Mobile solution for managing hardware-based wireless locks, including sites, commissioning, configuration, and user management.
responsibilities: Clarified requirements with stakeholders and audited a legacy Objective-C codebase.
Led refactoring of key modules and strengthened CI/CD practices.
Conducted systematic code reviews for secure and reliable hardware lock interaction.

content.name: Enterprise communication tool
content.overview: Cloud-based team collaboration platform for secure video meetings, real-time messaging, content collaboration, file sharing, and whiteboarding.
responsibilities: Partnered with UX and product to refine requirements and implement reusable iOS components.
Improved CI/CD and release hygiene across messaging and meeting experiences.
Provided governance, stakeholder alignment, and delivery oversight.

content.name: White-label banking app
content.overview: White-label banking app for accounts, cards, OTP verification, PIN and biometric identification, transaction monitoring, and transfers.
responsibilities: Coordinated iOS and Android streams.
Communicated with the Product Owner and third-party vendors.
Clarified requirements, designed components, reviewed code, and supported CI/CD.

content.name: Mobile analytics framework
content.summary: Designed and developed core components of an iOS library for anonymous activity and environment analysis.

content.name: Mobile trading app
content.summary: Led iOS and Android streams for a global fiat and crypto trading platform with real-time data and advanced indicators.

content.name: Airline mobile app redesign
content.summary: Led mobile and backend streams through a major travel app redesign with trip history, alerts, membership cards, boarding passes, and hardware/SaaS integrations.

content.name: Airport lounge locator app
content.summary: Designed and implemented iOS components for a white-label airport lounge locator with brand customization.

content.name: Airline traveler app
content.summary: Led iOS delivery for a traveler experience app with check-in, itinerary access, flight status, loyalty visibility, Passbook, and Apple Watch support.

content.name: White label mobile utility payment app
content.summary: Led cross-platform delivery for a secure prepaid energy payment app with balance top-up, transaction history, and card management.

content.name: Cross-platform insurance mobile app
content.summary: Led Agile delivery for a cross-platform travel insurance workflow app with travel detail capture and certificate generation.

content.name: Internal tablet content app
content.summary: Led iOS stream for an internal tablet app port of a company website with offline mode, dynamic UI, media, web content, and rich animations.

content.name: Digital signature proof of concept
content.summary: Implemented iPad workflows for capturing signatures on PDFs and integrating signature-capture SDK components.

content.name: Mobile payment framework
content.summary: Developed core Objective-C framework modules for a reusable payment SDK with REST/JSON integration, Core Data patterns, and automated testing.

content.name: Marketing campaign mobile app
content.summary: Led iOS stream within a multi-stream white-label target marketing program with offline mode, lazy synchronization, Google Maps, SQLite caching, and SDK delivery.

content.name: Digital concierge tablet demo app
content.summary: Designed architecture and implemented an Objective-C iPad proof of concept for premium service integration and stakeholder demonstration.

content.name: Trip planner mobile app
content.summary: Defined architecture and UI design for a consumer trip planning app with itineraries, packing lists, weather, currency, and destination guide integrations.

content.name: Live event support mobile app
content.summary: Owned architecture and iOS implementation for a major live event operational support app with schedules, news, points of interest, chat, task distribution, and social sharing.

content.name: City guide mobile app
content.summary: Designed and delivered a location-aware city guide with maps, directions, points of interest, and Facebook/Twitter integration.

content.name: Branded football game
content.summary: Implemented multiplayer functionality and GameKit integration for a branded 3D football game.

content.name: Tablet UI sketch tool
content.summary: Designed architecture and implemented an iPad UI mockup tool with drag-and-drop widgets, editable properties, PDF export, and email sharing.

content.name: Mobile banking proof of concept
content.summary: Created architecture and implemented an internal iOS banking proof of concept for account access and core banking operations.

content.name: Concurrent testing framework
content.summary: Developed a configurable concurrent unit testing framework in C++ for public API and integration-style test scenarios.

content.name: B2B white-label commerce app
content.summary: Led iOS and Android streams for a B2B white-label commerce app integrated with Hybris SAP ERP through customized OCC APIs.

content.name: Hospitality mobile application
content.summary: Led Scrum ceremonies and Agile coaching for a resort search, comparison, media, local save, and sharing experience.

content.name: Financial news mobile app
content.summary: Developed architecture and iOS implementation for financial news, market indexes, portfolios, reminders, push notifications, and stock comparison.

content.name: Furniture catalogue and ordering app
content.summary: Designed architecture and implemented iOS features for furniture browsing, quote booking, ordering, and card payments.

content.name: Football scores mobile app
content.summary: Architected and implemented an iOS app for match schedules, live scores, results, league tables, news, and media clips.

content.name: Product catalogue mobile app
content.summary: Designed and built an interactive adhesive product catalogue with surface selection, filters, and nearest-stockist map integration.

content.name: Dental practice management desktop app
content.summary: Designed project architecture and C++ implementation for a client-server patient records system with instant messaging and asynchronous sockets.

content.name: Medical imaging and analysis app
content.summary: Developed a cross-platform Qt medical GUI application for X-ray image management, patient data, image processing, cephalometric analysis, and reporting.

content.name: Smart utility metering system
content.summary: Built low-level components for remote resource metering, power-line communication protocols, and embedded software for MSP430x and AVR microcontrollers.
